invariants: proof key is sha256 of canonical key material only
all file bindings use repository-relative regular non-symlink files
input policy and implementation file groups are separately bound
parameters and execution environment are part of key material
only PASS proofs may be reused
T0 T3 T4 and live-external-state proofs are never reusable
reuse requires candidate self-integrity and equality with freshly recomputed expected proof key
